column1: # 简体中文 (zh-cn) interface catalog for AniCraft.
# Written from the plain meaning of the English strings in ordinary computing
# vocabulary (clean room); no other product's localisation was consulted or copied.
# Format: context <TAB> English <TAB> translation; @plural rows carry this
# language's forms (Chinese has one); @id rows map ids to labels.

column2: // Type or paste a frame script
100 %: as wide as it is tall. Less flattens the tip, for calligraphic strokes
column3: 100%：宽度与高度相等。数值越小笔尖越扁，适合书法笔触

column2: A bone ends on another symbol instance: release over the instance it should move.
column3: 骨骼的末端落在另一个元件实例上：在它要移动的实例上松开鼠标即可。

column2: A frame script: it runs while the movie plays. Pick it for a keyframe in the Actions panel (F9)
column3: 帧脚本：随影片播放而运行。在动作面板（F9）中可为关键帧选择它

column2: A list of actions, in order
column3: 按顺序排列的动作列表

column2: A pinned bone, and the bones it hangs from, stay put while you drag the bones below it
column3: 拖动其下方的骨骼时，已固定的骨骼以及它所依附的骨骼会保持不动

column2: A recovery copy of your unsaved work. If AniCraft closes unexpectedly, the next start offers it back.
column3: 未保存工作的恢复副本。如果 AniCraft 意外关闭，下次启动时会提供恢复。

column2: A script runs only when all of it is in the ActionScript 3.0 subset AniCraft runs: timeline control (stop, play, go to a frame or label), mouse listeners, trace, and setting x, y, alpha, visible, rotation and scale on named instances. Until then it is kept as written and doesn't run.
column3: 只有当脚本全部位于 AniCraft 所支持的 ActionScript 3.0 子集内时才会运行：时间轴控制（stop、play、跳转到帧或标签）、鼠标监听器、trace，以及对命名实例设置 x、y、alpha、visible、rotation 和 scale。在此之前，脚本会按原样保留且不会运行。

column2: A sound keeps at least one point
ANICRAFT_STAGE_RENDERER is set, and it takes precedence over this choice.
column3: 已设置 ANICRAFT_STAGE_RENDERER，它优先于此项选择。

column2: Add a point where the object is on frame {frame}, pinned to it: nothing moves now, and the object passes the point then however the path is edited
column3: 在对象位于帧 {frame} 时的位置添加一个点并将其固定到该帧：现在不会移动任何东西，且无论之后如何编辑路径，对象届时都会经过该点
在帧 {frame} 添加 {property} 关键帧
为 {action} 添加其他快捷键
添加到选择/从选择中移除

column2: Added a camera. Drag on the stage to pan it, turn it with the round handle, zoom with the wheel. {undo} to undo.
column3: 已添加摄像机。在舞台上拖动可平移，用圆形手柄旋转，用滚轮缩放。按 {undo} 可撤销。

column2: Added a point to the motion path. {undo} to undo.
column3: 已向运动路径添加一个点。按 {undo} 可撤销。
已添加一个点。按 {undo} 可撤销。

column2: Added shape hint {letter}: drag it onto an edge here, then onto the matching edge on the tween's last keyframe.
column3: 已添加形状提示 {letter}：将它拖到此处的一条边上，再拖到补间最后一个关键帧上的对应边上。

column2: Adds it at the centre of the view, on the active layer (Enter, or drag it onto the stage)
column3: 将其添加到视图中心的活动图层上（按 Enter，或将其拖到舞台上）
相对舞台对齐 开/关

column2: Align to the stage instead of the selection's bounds (a single shape always aligns to the stage)
column3: 以舞台为基准对齐，而不是以选择的边界为基准（单个形状始终以舞台为基准对齐）

column2: Also morphs one shape into another
column3: 还可以将一个形状变形为另一个形状

column2: Always render off the UI thread. The window never waits; the picture can trail by a frame.
column3: 始终在 UI 线程以外渲染。窗口从不需要等待，但画面可能滞后一帧。

column2: An entry point of a frame-script plug-in (WebAssembly)
column3: 帧脚本插件（WebAssembly）的一个入口点

column2: AniCraft is free software: MIT OR Apache-2.0, at your option.
column3: AniCraft 是自由软件：采用 MIT OR Apache-2.0 许可证，可任选其一。

column2: Animate each property on its own curve
column3: 让每个属性沿各自的曲线做动画

column2: Animate this span's object property by property
column3: 逐个属性为该片段的对象制作动画

column2: Animate this span's object property by property (edit the curves in the Motion Editor)
column3: 逐个属性为该片段的对象制作动画（在动作编辑器中编辑曲线）

column2: At the centre of the view, on the active layer (Enter; or drag onto the stage)
column3: 在视图中心的活动图层上（按 Enter；或拖到舞台上）
更改达到此次数后自动保存

column2: Autosave failed: {error}. Save your work to be safe; AniCraft will keep trying.
column3: 自动保存失败：{error}。为防意外请手动保存工作；AniCraft 会继续尝试。

column2: Autosave is off on this system, so there is nothing to recover
column3: 此系统上自动保存已关闭，因此没有可恢复的内容

column2: Autosave is off: this system has no settings folder
column3: 自动保存已关闭：此系统没有设置文件夹

column2: Back to the stage as it is: centred, 100 %, no turn, no tint
column3: 回到舞台原样：居中、100%、无旋转、无着色

column2: Back to the straight path the X and Y curves trace
column3: 回到 X 和 Y 曲线勾画的直线路径

column2: Blue keys are pinned motion path points: drag one to move its point
column3: 蓝色关键帧是已固定的运动路径点：拖动即可移动对应的点

column2: Changed the stroke's width. {undo} to undo.
column3: 已更改描边宽度。按 {undo} 可撤销。
已清除关键帧 — {undo} 可撤销

column2: Clears every visible, unlocked layer at this frame, as double-clicking the Eraser tool does. You can undo it
column3: 清除此帧上所有可见且未锁定的图层，效果如同双击橡皮擦工具。可以撤销

column2: Click a fill or an enclosed area to pour it.
column3: 单击填充或封闭的区域即可倒入颜色。

column2: Click a fill to pick its colour, gradient or bitmap (then pour it with the Paint Bucket), or a line to pick its colour, width and profile (then apply it with the Ink Bottle). With shapes selected, the picked style goes onto them. Shift-click picks into the other swatch only.
column3: 单击填充可拾取其颜色、渐变或位图（随后用油漆桶倒色），单击线条可拾取其颜色、宽度和宽度曲线（随后用墨水瓶应用）。选中图形时，拾取的样式会应用到所选图形上。按住 Shift 单击则只会拾取到另一个色板。

column2: Click a key to change it or + to add one; right-click a key to remove it. Changes save as you go.
column3: 单击某个键进行更改，或单击 + 添加一个；右键单击某个键可将其移除。更改即时保存。

column2: Click a shape to give it the current stroke colour and width.
column3: 单击图形可为其应用当前描边颜色和宽度。

column2: Click a shape to give it this line.
column3: 单击图形可为其应用此线条。

column2: Click a shape to show its points; on a merged drawing, the points of everything connected to it. Drag points or handles to reshape (a shared point moves every shape that has it; a smooth point's handles stay in line, Alt moves one alone); drag a line or fill to move everything connected. Shift adds to the point selection, drag on empty space to marquee points, arrow keys nudge them. Double-click an edge to add a point, Delete removes points, and right-click makes a point smooth or a corner. A motion path's points edit the same way (its ends stay).
column3: 单击图形可显示其节点；对于合并绘制的图形，会显示与其相连的所有内容的节点。拖动节点或手柄可改变形状（共享节点会带动所有包含它的图形；平滑节点的手柄保持共线，按住 Alt 可单独移动一个）；拖动线条或填充可移动与之相连的所有内容。按住 Shift 可加选节点，在空白处拖动可框选节点，按方向键可微调节点。双击边线可添加节点，Delete 可删除节点，右键单击可将节点设为平滑或转角。动作路径的节点可用同样方式编辑（其端点保持不动）。

column2: Click inside an outline to fill it (on the layer's lines), or on a fill to recolour it. The gap size closes small openings.
column3: 单击轮廓内部进行填充（作用于图层的线条），或单击填充重新着色。间隙大小可封闭小开口。

column2: Click to add a colour stop
Click to change · right-click to remove
column3: 单击可更改 · 右键单击可移除

column2: Click to place corner points, drag to pull smooth handles (Alt moves one handle). Click the first point to close; Enter, Esc or a click on the last point finishes. Backspace removes the last point. Alt-click a selected shape, a merged drawing's line or a motion path to add a point to it. Points snap to points and lines while Snap to Objects is on.
column3: 单击放置转角点，拖动可拉出平滑手柄（Alt 可单独移动一个手柄）。单击第一个点闭合路径；按 Enter、Esc 或单击最后一个点即可结束。Backspace 删除上一个点。按住 Alt 单击所选图形、合并绘制图形的线条或动作路径，可在其上添加点。开启“贴齐对象”后，点会贴齐到点和线条。

column2: Click to select, drag to move, drag on empty space to marquee-select. Shift adds to the selection.
column3: 单击可选择，拖动可移动，在空白处拖动可框选。按住 Shift 可加选。

column2: Click to type new text, or click text to edit it. Esc or a click elsewhere finishes. The options set the font, size and colour; double-click text with the Selection tool to edit it too.
column3: 单击以输入新文本，或单击已有文本进行编辑。按 Esc 或单击其他位置结束。选项可设置字体、大小和颜色；用选择工具双击文本也可进行编辑。

column2: Click to zoom in, Alt-click to zoom out. Ctrl+wheel zooms anywhere.
column3: 单击放大，按住 Alt 单击缩小。Ctrl+滚轮可在任意位置缩放。

column2: Code in a scripting language (such as an Animate document's ActionScript), kept with the document. ActionScript 3.0 runs when it uses only timeline control, mouse listeners, trace and instance properties
column3: 以脚本语言编写的代码（如 Animate 文档中的 ActionScript），随文档一起保存。当 ActionScript 3.0 只使用时间轴控制、鼠标监听器、trace 和实例属性时即可运行

column2: Colour of the frames after the playhead
Colour of the frames before the playhead
Corners sharper than this are bevelled: how far a point may reach, in stroke widths
column3: 比这更尖锐的转角会呈斜角：点最多可延伸的距离，以描边宽度为单位
删除此自动保存的副本
已删除图层 — {undo} 可撤销
已删除场景 — {undo} 可撤销
已删除声音 — {undo} 可撤销
已删除填充。{undo} 可撤销。
已删除线条。{undo} 可撤销。

column2: Deletes the selected items and folders (Delete)
column3: 删除所选项目和文件夹（Delete）
已放弃自动保存的副本

column2: Discarding deletes this work for good. This cannot be undone.
column3: 放弃将永久删除这份工作成果。此操作无法撤销。

column2: Drag a corner or edge to scale (Shift keeps proportions, Alt scales from the centre), just outside a corner to rotate (Shift snaps 15°), inside to move.
column3: 拖动角点或边可缩放（Shift 保持比例，Alt 从中心缩放）；在角点外侧稍外拖动可旋转（Shift 吸附 15°）；在内部拖动可移动。

column2: Drag a key up or down to change it, or a handle to shape the ease. Double-click to add a key.
column3: 上下拖动关键点可更改其值，拖动手柄可调整缓动形状。双击可添加关键点。

column2: Drag bones or instances with the Selection tool to pose; a pose at another frame keys it, and poses tween.
column3: 使用选择工具拖动骨骼或实例来摆出姿势；在另一帧摆放姿势会为其创建关键帧，姿势之间会自动生成补间。

column2: Drag from the centre to draw a star.
column3: 从中心向外拖动以绘制星形。

column2: Drag on the stage to pan the camera, drag the round handle to turn it, and use the wheel to zoom (each drag is one undo step). Picking the tool adds a camera if the scene has none.
column3: 在舞台上拖动可平移摄像机，拖动圆形手柄可旋转摄像机，使用滚轮可缩放（每次拖动为一步撤销）。若场景中没有摄像机，选择此工具时会添加一台。

column2: Drag to choose how many frames onion skin shows before and after the playhead
column3: 拖动以选择洋葱皮在播放头前后显示的帧数

column2: Drag to choose the frames onion skin shows (anchored: they stay when the playhead moves)
column3: 拖动以选择洋葱皮显示的帧（已锚定：播放头移动时这些帧保持不变）

column2: Drag to draw a line. Shift snaps to 45°.
column3: 拖动以绘制线条。Shift 吸附到 45°。

column2: Drag to draw a rectangle. Shift draws a square.
column3: 拖动以绘制矩形。按住 Shift 可绘制正方形。

column2: Drag to draw an oval. Shift draws a circle.
column3: 拖动以绘制椭圆形。按住 Shift 可绘制正圆形。

column2: Drag to draw freehand. The options bar sets Smooth, Straighten or Ink.
column3: 拖动以徒手绘制。选项栏可设置平滑、伸直或墨水模式。

column2: Drag to erase lines and fills drawn with Object Drawing off (drawing objects and symbols are kept). [ and ] change the size; the options set the shape and erase mode, and the Faucet deletes a whole fill or line with a click. Double-click the tool to erase everything on the stage.
column3: 拖动可擦除在未开启对象绘制时绘制的线条和填充（绘制对象和元件会保留）。按 [ 和 ] 可更改大小；选项可设置形状和擦除模式，水龙头单击即可删除整个填充或线条。双击工具可擦除舞台上的所有内容。

column2: Drag to paint filled shapes in the fill colour (a click paints a dab). [ and ] change the size; the options set the shape, smoothing and paint mode.
column3: 拖动以填充颜色绘制填充图形（单击则涂出一小块）。按 [ 和 ] 可更改大小；选项可设置形状、平滑度和绘制模式。

column2: Drag to pan the stage. Space works with any tool.
column3: 拖动以平移舞台。按住 Space 可配合任何工具使用。

column2: Dragged points and selections snap to points, lines and fill edges within 10 pixels (the magnet under the tools)
column3: 拖动的点和选区在 10 像素范围内会吸附到点、线条和填充边缘（工具下方的磁铁）

column2: Draw a stroke along the glyph edges
Draw onion frames as outlines only
column3: 洋葱皮帧仅以轮廓显示

column2: Drawing on {adapter}, straight into the window.
column3: 在 {adapter} 上绘制，直接呈现到窗口。

column2: Drawing on {adapter}, then copied to the window (slower: the window's graphics device can't be shared).
column3: 在 {adapter} 上绘制，再复制到窗口（较慢：无法共享窗口的图形设备）。

column2: Draws the stage on the graphics card, and on the CPU when there is no card that can. The picture is the same either way.
column3: 在显卡上绘制舞台，没有可用显卡时则用 CPU 绘制。两种方式的画面完全相同。

column2: Edit Envelope: the volume of each channel over the sound's time
column3: 编辑包络：声音播放期间每个声道的音量变化

column2: Edit Multiple Frames moves, transforms, aligns, deletes, copies and pastes artwork on several keyframes; for this, turn it off and work frame by frame.
column3: 编辑多帧可对多个关键帧上的图形进行移动、变形、对齐、删除、拷贝和粘贴；若要编辑单个帧，请关闭此功能并逐帧操作。

column2: Edit Multiple Frames: the keyframes between the onion markers show at full strength. Select and drag artwork to move it on all of them; drag the markers on the frame ruler to choose the frames.
column3: 编辑多帧：洋葱皮标记之间的关键帧将以完整效果显示。选择并拖动图形可在所有这些帧上移动它；拖动帧标尺上的标记可选择帧范围。

column2: Edit the property curves and eases
Edit what it does on clicks and the pointer ({key})
column3: 编辑其单击和指针交互时的行为（{key}）

column2: Edits show immediately; heavy scenes render in the background with an outline preview.
column3: 编辑立即生效；复杂场景会在后台渲染，并以轮廓预览显示。

column2: Empty frame — press F7 for a blank keyframe
column3: 空帧 — 按 F7 可创建空白关键帧

column2: Enter applies · Esc cancels · one undo step
column3: Enter 应用 · Esc 取消 · 仅一步撤销
Enter 确认 · Esc 取消
Enter 保存 · Esc 取消

column2: Erases fills only, leaving lines alone.
column3: 仅擦除填充，不影响线条。

column2: Erases lines and fills on the layer.
column3: 擦除图层上的线条和填充。

column2: Erases lines only, leaving fills alone.
column3: 仅擦除线条，不影响填充。

column2: Erases only inside the fill where the stroke starts.
column3: 仅擦除描边起点所在填充的内部。

column2: Esc cancels · click the red button to proceed
column3: Esc 取消 · 点击红色按钮继续

column2: Every edit renders before the next frame. Lowest latency; can stutter on very heavy scenes.
column3: 每次编辑都会在下一帧之前渲染。延迟最低；在非常复杂的场景中可能出现卡顿。

column2: Every shortcut is back to the defaults.
column3: 所有快捷键已恢复为默认值。
导出 HTML canvas（单个网页）

column2: Export Lottie animation (JSON, for web and apps)
column3: 导出 Lottie 动画（JSON，用于网页和应用）
导出 PNG 序列到文件夹

column2: Export audio (the movie's soundtrack as a WAV)
column3: 导出音频（将影片的音轨保存为 WAV）

column2: Export sprite sheet (PNG + JSON frame map)
column3: 导出精灵表（PNG + JSON 帧映射）

column2: Export video (.webm or .mp4, made with your ffmpeg)
column3: 导出视频（.webm 或 .mp4，由你安装的 ffmpeg 生成）

column2: Exported {path} ({secs} s). No sounds play in that range, so the file is silent.
column3: 已导出 {path}（{secs} 秒）。该范围内没有任何声音播放，因此文件是静音的。

column2: Falls from full volume to silence while it plays
column3: 播放时从全音量渐弱至无声
已填充该区域。{undo} 可撤销。

column2: Fits smooth curves to the stroke, keeping sharp corners.
column3: 为描边拟合平滑曲线，同时保留尖锐转角。

column2: Folders and guide layers don't run actions. Pick another layer in the timeline.
column3: 文件夹和引导层不会运行动作。请在时间轴中选择其他图层。

column2: Folders hold layers, not frames. Hiding or locking the folder hides or locks everything in it; move layers in under it with Up and Down.
column3: 文件夹容纳的是图层，而不是帧。隐藏或锁定文件夹会同时隐藏或锁定其中的所有内容；使用“上移”和“下移”可将图层移入其下。

column2: Follows the hand closely with little smoothing.
column3: 紧跟手的移动，几乎不做平滑。

column2: Font “{name}” is not installed; using the bundled font
column3: 字体“{name}”未安装；正在使用内置字体

column2: Frame labels survive frames being added or moved
column3: 帧标签不会因帧的插入或移动而丢失

column2: Frame rate, and the time the last picture took to draw
column3: 帧率，以及绘制最后一幅画面所用的时间
已设置帧脚本 — {undo} 可撤销

column2: Frame zoom: frame width (Ctrl+wheel over the frames)
column3: 帧缩放：按帧宽度（在帧上按住 Ctrl 并滚动滚轮）

column2: Frame {frame} is empty on this layer. Add a blank keyframe ({key}) to give it actions.
column3: 帧 {frame} 在此图层上为空。添加空白关键帧（{key}）即可为其添加动作。

column2: Frame {frame} · point {anchor} of the motion path: drag to move the point
column3: 帧 {frame} · 运动路径上的点 {anchor}：拖动可移动该点

column2: Frames farther from the playhead are fainter
column3: 距播放头越远的帧越淡

column2: Frames here don't run (graphic and button timelines, guide layers); the script is kept with the document.
column3: 此处的帧不会运行（图形元件和按钮元件的时间轴、引导层）；脚本仍随文档保存。

column2: Give every property's segment at this frame this ease
column3: 将此缓动应用于该帧处每个属性的片段

column2: Heard for {time} ({why}). Presets are shaped over this time; editing one makes it Custom.
column3: 声音可持续听到 {time}（{why}）。预设按此时长塑形；编辑某个预设后会变为自定义。

column2: Hover a stroke to see its width points. Drag a point's handle to widen or narrow the stroke there (Alt: one side only), drag its dot to slide it along, or drag anywhere on the stroke to add a point. Click a point and press Delete to remove it.
